name: list
description: A bulleted or numbered list of short text items. Use ordered for steps or rankings.

use.when: short items, in order or not: steps, ideas, names.
use.not: paragraphs, which are text; data with columns, which is a table; or things to tick off, which are task records in a collection, each with its Done box.
use.with: a heading or a label right before it.

label.title: List name
label.description: What the list is, shown as a heading over it: To pack, Ideas. Leave out when a heading right before it already says it.

level.title: Heading level
level.description: The level of its name as a heading: 3 under a section's heading, 2 on its own.

a11y.role: list, under a heading when it has a name

wcag.notes: Real ul/ol markup so assistive tech announces item counts and positions (1.3.1). Its name is a visible heading, not an aria-label, so everyone sees what the list is for, it is reached by heading, and it translates (2.4.6). No empty items: a blank mark and a wrong count.

machine.identify: A ul or ol. Each li is one item. Its name, when it has one, is the heading right before it.
